ValidationRule.description: If Screen Sharing equals True then Screen Sharing Number of Operators cannot be blank or zero
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Screen_Sharing__c = TRUE, OR(ISNULL( Screen_Sharing_Number_of_Operators__c ), Screen_Sharing_Number_of_Operators__c = 0))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Screen Sharing equals True then Screen Sharing Number of Operators cannot be blank or zero
